card.name: Advice to check before acting
card.fires_on: Words in advice sentences about doing a check or test in advance, right after a cue like 'before', 'prior to', 'should' or 'check'. It fires on the verb or linking word that begins the check, such as search, test, check first, or that.

modes.label: Check-first verbs
modes.description: The verb or word that starts a preliminary check after 'should' or 'check'.
modes.example: you should<< search>> to see if your mark will infringe

modes.label: Before/prior to linking words
modes.description: Linking words right after a 'before' or 'prior' cue in a precaution sentence.
modes.example: Compatibility should be assured<< prior>> to administering these drugs together.

modes.label: Patch-test instructions
modes.description: Words inside a skin test instruction given before using a product.
modes.example: Test for skin sensitivity before using by applying a<< small>> amount to an unbroken patch of skin

card.writes: It promotes words meaning in advance, such as beforehand, ahead and foresee, so the text continues with advance-preparation wording.
card.plain: It lights up when a text tells you to check, test or plan something before you go ahead.
